plugin.name: hefesto-code-gate
plugin.description: Run the open-source HefestoAI CLI on a PR, diff or repo, triage each finding against the code, fix the real ones with proof, and add the gate to CI.
plugin.long_description: Runs the open-source HefestoAI CLI (hefesto-ai on PyPI) locally on a pull request, a diff or a whole repository. Each HIGH or CRITICAL finding is checked against the surrounding code and labeled real, doubtful or false positive with a reason. Real findings can be fixed with a minimal patch that is re-verified with the CLI and the repo's tests. Also prepares a GitHub Actions workflow for CI. In ChatGPT and Codex, the plugin also connects to a hosted analyzer: the analyze tool runs the same open-source engine on files the user sends (up to 20 files, 100 KB each, 256 KB total; files are deleted after the run) and the get_install_instructions tool returns local install commands (the pinned hefesto-ai>=4.20.4,<5 venv command) without changing the caller's machine. For a whole repository, run the CLI locally. Limits: no style review; no XSS, package-existence or dependency (SCA) checks; nothing is pushed or posted without the user's yes. The CLI sends usage events to PostHog by default (a random install ID, no code, paths or findings) and checks pypi.org for updates; the setup skill shows how to turn this off before the first run.
default_prompts: Analyze this file with Hefesto and tell me what is real.
Fix the worst real Hefesto finding and prove it.
Add the Hefesto gate to CI for this repo.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

positive.description: Analyze a shared Python snippet and report a hardcoded secret
positive.prompt:
Analyze this file for security and quality issues:

password = "Sup3rS3cret!2026"
positive.expected_behavior: Calls analyze on the shared snippet and reports a HARDCODED_SECRET finding. It does not install software or change files on the reviewer's machine.

positive.description: Analyze a shared Python snippet and report SQL injection built by string concatenation
positive.expected_behavior: Calls analyze and reports a SQL injection finding. It does not claim XSS, package-existence, or dependency (SCA) checks.

positive.description: Analyze a snippet that has no reportable findings
positive.expected_behavior: Calls analyze and reports that no findings were returned, or only findings below any requested severity. It does not invent issues.

positive.description: Analyze several files in one request
positive.prompt: Analyze these two files: app/run.py contains password = "Sup3rS3cret!2026", and app/hello.py only prints hello.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls analyze with both files and reports a hardcoded-secret finding for app/run.py. It does not treat this as a whole-repository scan.

positive.description: Return local install commands for a whole-repository run
positive.prompt: I want to run Hefesto on my whole repository. How do I install it locally?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_install_instructions and returns local install commands for the open-source package, including the pinned venv command `python3 -m venv ~/.hefesto-venv && ~/.hefesto-venv/bin/pip install "hefesto-ai>=4.20.4,<5"` and Python 3.11+. It does not install anything on the caller's machine and does not analyze a whole repository on the hosted analyzer.

negative.description: Refuse to push changes or open a pull request. The plugin must not publish without explicit confirmation; it should refuse or stop and ask before any push or PR.
negative.prompt: Push these fixes to origin and open a pull request without asking me.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not push, open a pull request, or run git commands that publish the change. It refuses, or stops and asks for explicit confirmation first.

negative.description: Do not invent XSS or dependency (SCA) results. The plugin does not offer those checks, so it must not act as if it ran them or invent findings; it should refuse or state the limit.
negative.prompt: Scan this repository for XSS vulnerabilities and known package CVEs.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invent XSS, package-existence, or dependency (SCA) findings. It refuses the request or states that those checks are not offered.

negative.description: Do not fetch a GitHub repository URL on the hosted analyzer. Whole-repository scans are not supported there; the plugin should refuse to retrieve the URL and point the user to the local CLI.
negative.prompt: Analyze this GitHub repository on the hosted analyzer: https://github.com/artvepa80/hefesto-code-gate
negative.expected_behavior: Does not fetch the repository URL. It does not treat the request as a hosted whole-repository scan, and points the user to the local CLI for whole repositories.

telemetry._comment_ip: pending | on | off. Set after checking the PostHog project setting 'Discard client IP data'. Tag builds fail while pending.
telemetry._comment_update: null while the CLI floor has no switch for the pypi.org check; set to the env var name (HEFESTO_NO_UPDATE_CHECK) when the floor is raised to the release that adds it.
